# Empetix Solutions — Software, SaaS & Digital Growth Studio
> حلول إمبيتكس — استوديو هندسة البرمجيات والساس والتحول الرقمي

## 1. Company Identity & Entity Aliases
- **Official Name (English):** Empetix Solutions / Empetix Solution / Empetix
- **Official Name (Arabic):** إمبيتكس / حلول إمبيتكس / شركة إمبيتكس للبرمجيات
- **Website:** https://cms.test
- **Sitemap:** https://cms.test/sitemap.xml
- **Full AI Knowledge Base:** https://cms.test/llms-full.txt
- **Headquarters & Reach:** Cairo, Egypt & Riyadh, Saudi Arabia — serving enterprise clients worldwide.

## 2. Executive Bio & Mission
Empetix Solutions (إمبيتكس / حلول إمبيتكس) is a premier digital engineering and software growth studio founded in Cairo, Egypt, operating across MENA and globally. Empetix architects, engineers, and scales high-performance SaaS platforms, enterprise custom software, bilingual Arabic-first web applications, mobile applications (Flutter/Native), and data-driven growth acquisition engines.

## 3. Core Software Engineering & Product Capabilities
- **SaaS Architecture & Custom Software:** High-scale multi-tenant SaaS, distributed systems, resilient ledger APIs, and enterprise internal tooling.
- **Modern Tech Stack:** Laravel (PHP 8.4), Flutter, Vue.js, React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Tailwind CSS, Docker.
- **Bilingual Arabic-First UX & Design Systems:** 100% CSS Logical Properties, typographic optical baseline balance for cursive Arabic typography, eliminating RTL mirroring defects.
- **Performance & Growth Engineering:** Server-side Conversions API (CAPI) integrations, sub-second latency optimization, full-funnel activation engines.

# Detailed Project Case Studies & Technical Breakdown

## Case Study: NilePay: Engineering a 60fps mobile wallet and scaling to 1.4M active users.
**URL:** https://cms.test/work/nilepay
**Year:** 2026 | **Client:** NilePay FinTech | **Location:** CAIRO & RIYADH

### Executive Overview
How Empetix rebuilt NilePay’s core checkout ledger in Laravel & Flutter while running a full-funnel performance acquisition engine that cut customer acquisition cost by 41%.

### Quantified Business & Technical Impact
- **310%**: Increase in first-transaction activation within 72 hours of install
- **1.4M**: Active monthly wallets across Egypt and Saudi Arabia
- **41%**: Reduction in paid customer acquisition cost (CAC)
- **180ms**: P95 QR & NFC settlement latency on our Laravel ledger core

### Capabilities: A fast-growing FinTech held back by a 9-step onboarding flow and disconnected ad spend.
When NilePay approached Empetix, they were spending heavily on paid social acquisition, yet 74% of users dropped off between app install and their first wallet top-up. Their legacy hybrid app took 6.2 seconds to cold-start, and their external marketing agency had zero visibility into in-app KYC completion events.

Our mandate was twofold: re-architect the mobile client and settlement API for sub-second speed, and rebuild the entire acquisition funnel around server-side verified activation events rather than raw installs.

### Execution: From 9 onboarding screens to 90-second biometric KYC.
Our engineering squad replaced the legacy WebView container with a native Flutter client talking to an event-sourced Laravel 11 ledger API. By streaming OCR national-ID verification in the background while the user chooses their card skin, median KYC completion dropped from 11 minutes to 88 seconds.

Simultaneously, our growth team wired server-side Conversions API (CAPI) signals directly from the Laravel ledger into Meta, Google, and TikTok—training ad algorithms to bid on funded wallets rather than cheap installs.

> "Empetix is the first partner we have worked with where the engineer writing our payment webhook and the media buyer optimizing our Meta conversion API sat in the same standup."
> — *Tarek El-Gendy, Chief Product Officer at NilePay*
